- Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO following allegations regarding his relationship and GPU scarcity claims. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261113/p36#a261113p36), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.techpowerup.com/354814/nvidia-allegedly-engineered-scarcity-by-funding-ai-startups-to-buy-its-gpus))
- The FAA issued a nationwide ground stop for US flights, with reports linking the disruption to an AI traffic control system. ([Scientific American Content: Global](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/faa-grounds-all-u-s-flights-days-after-expanding-its-ai-air-traffic-system/), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/faa-ground-stop-nationwide-airports-lines-flights-delayed-photos-2026-11))
- Anthropic is preparing for a record-breaking IPO while releasing its new Claude Fable 5.2 model for demanding coding tasks. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/anthropic-can-already-retrain-mythos-with-a-fraction-of-the-compute-originally-needed-says-former-researcher-coxon/), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-anthropic-ceo-investors-safety-jerks.html), [The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/claude-fable-5-2-vs-gpt-6-astra/), [The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/claude-fable-5-2-vs-fable-5-1/))

### Jensen Huang resigns from Nvidia amid allegations and market impact
Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO following allegations of misleading leadership about his relationship with Alice Huang and engineering GPU scarcity, sparking a petition for his reinstatement and impacting AI startup funding and open models. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261113/p36#a261113p36), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.techpowerup.com/354814/nvidia-allegedly-engineered-scarcity-by-funding-ai-startups-to-buy-its-gpus), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261113/p40#a261113p40), [Analytics India Magazine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2KE-0ZY0-Zo))

### FAA issues nationwide ground stop linked to AI traffic control system
The FAA issued a nationwide ground stop for US flights, with reports linking the disruption to an AI traffic control system. ([Scientific American Content: Global](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/faa-grounds-all-u-s-flights-days-after-expanding-its-ai-air-traffic-system/), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/faa-ground-stop-nationwide-airports-lines-flights-delayed-photos-2026-11), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/faa-issues-nationwide-ground-stop-after-communications-problems/), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.theatlantic.com/ideas/2026/11/faa-grounding-flights-cancelled/689444/))

### Anthropic prepares for record IPO
Anthropic is moving forward with what could be the largest IPO in history, with CEO Dario Amodei pitching investors on safety and company culture. The company has also highlighted technical efficiencies, such as reduced compute needs for retraining its Mythos model. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/anthropic-can-already-retrain-mythos-with-a-fraction-of-the-compute-originally-needed-says-former-researcher-coxon/), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-anthropic-ceo-investors-safety-jerks.html), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-14/anthropic-ipo-tests-investor-appetite-for-ai-video), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/anthropic-ceo-amodei-admits-theres-a-huge-uncertainty-in-whats-going-to-happen-next-year-days-before-a-record-ipo/))

### Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 model
Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2, a model positioned for demanding coding tasks, which features fewer refusals and lower token prices compared to its predecessor. ([The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/claude-fable-5-2-vs-gpt-6-astra/), [The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/claude-fable-5-2-vs-fable-5-1/))

### AI Poses Biggest Threat To Financial System And Wider Global Economy: Fed Survey
A Federal Reserve survey found that 87% of respondents view AI as a significant risk to U.S. and global financial stability, a marked increase compared to the 50% who said the same thing in spring. ([International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/ai-biggest-threat-us-financial-stability-fed-survey-3809770))

### Databento raises $100M Series C for market data APIs
Databento, a provider of market data APIs with contracts with major AI labs, raised a $100M Series C at a $1.1B valuation. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261114/p16#a261114p16))

### Tesla offers Cybercab for personal purchase
Tesla has announced that select customers can purchase the Cybercab, its fully autonomous vehicle, for personal use. The move marks a significant step in the company's autonomous driving strategy, though fine print details remain a point of scrutiny. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/tesla-announces-cybercab-personal-use), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/transportation/1033844/tesla-personal-cybercab-orders-299-subscription-fine-print))

### Amazon plans to gather product data to counter AI shopping agents
Amazon is planning to collect data on nearly every product sold, including by crawling rival sites, to ensure its product data is superior and to prevent AI shopping agents from favoring competitors. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261113/p37#a261113p37), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/amazons-plan-own-worlds-product-data-fight-ai-shopping-agents-2026-11-13/))
